subject.title: refactor(config): config-surface reduction tranche 1 — retire dead keys, dedupe channel schemas, add growth ratchet

question: Should this release preserve the published `TelegramDmThreadReplies` type alias as a deprecated type-only Plugin SDK compatibility export, or explicitly approve a breaking SDK removal?
rationale: The patch can mechanically retain the alias, but whether a published Plugin SDK type may be removed in this release is a maintainer-owned API-contract decision.

options.title: Retain a deprecated type-only alias
options.body: Keep the old export as a documented deprecated alias while runtime config continues to reject and doctor-migrate the retired field.

options.title: Approve the breaking SDK removal
options.body: Accept that existing third-party plugins importing the type must update in this release and document that SDK compatibility break explicitly.

recommendation.title: Retain a deprecated type-only alias
recommendation.body: Keep the old export as a documented deprecated alias while runtime config continues to reject and doctor-migrate the retired field.

likelyOwner.reason: The available PR history and branch ownership place this configuration and Plugin SDK compatibility decision with the author of the proposed reduction program.
